title: Police Rescue Baby From HIGHLY Incompetent Parents
description:
On April 22nd, 2022. A witness placed a 911 call when she saw a woman hanging from the back of a moving truck which eventually stopped, a man came out and pulled her out, leaving her on the side of the road then coming back and then trying to run her over, all while a baby was unstrapped in the back of the car. When Police found and interviewed the woman, it turned out that they were coming back from the beach & had been drinking. The woman stated that she had been originally driving but her boyfriend got mad about how erratic she was driving when she turned the corner & the baby who was (unstrapped) in the car seat flew & hit her head against the glass. The man got furious and tried to take over the driving & starting fighting with her on the road, going as far as to bite her, which is when the witness saw the woman hanging out the back of the car. The boyfriend was interviewed and gave more or less the same story however, leaving out some details. He had also been driving too & when police asked her to conduct the standard sobriety tests he refused and was placed under  arrest, then proceeded to run & resist arrest. The woman was also arrested for driving under the influence but she was not charged with that but was charged with child endangerment.
